create_task_launcher: create a TaskLauncher instance with a database, task run, and assignment data iterator to prepare for launching assignments
launch_units: launch all registered units on a TaskLauncher by providing a launch URL and starting the unit generator thread
launch_gold_unit: launch a gold evaluation unit for quality control by providing unit data and using the gold unit type index
expire_units: expire and clean up all units managed by a TaskLauncher to properly shut down the task run
resume_assignments: resume expired or rejected assignments from a previous task run by resetting their status and preparing them for relaunch
